subject: CS353
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos covering advanced data structures topics. For English, high-quality, highly-viewed tutorials from established educational channels like Gate Smashers and Jenny's Lectures were chosen. For Arabic, selections were made from popular academic-style lectures, though some topics had limited options passing all gates. No suitable Arabic video was found for 'B-Tree Height and Time Complexity Analysis' as none specifically covered the required mathematical proofs.
